choice_context: Characterizing variation in medical advice responses across 92 pairs
reasoning: The 20 dimensions were selected to ensure comprehensive coverage of the 21 observed themes, while maintaining independence and descriptive neutrality. Each dimension captures a distinct and observable property of medical advice responses, grounded in the domain of healthcare communication and advice delivery.

dimensions.name: Advice Specificity

low_pole.label: General
low_pole.description: Advice is broad, flexible, and not tailored to specific conditions or contexts.
low_pole.typical_person: A general practitioner or public health communicator

high_pole.label: Specific
high_pole.description: Advice is detailed, actionable, and tailored to specific symptoms, conditions, or scenarios.

example_contrast.low_option: Stay hydrated and rest.
example_contrast.high_option: Drink at least 2 liters of water and rest for 48 hours if experiencing mild dehydration.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on how detailed and actionable the advice is, from 0 (very general) to 5 (very specific).

dimensions.name: Format Structure

low_pole.label: Free-flowing
low_pole.description: Advice is presented in a narrative or conversational style without clear organization.

high_pole.label: Structured
high_pole.description: Advice is organized using templates, lists, or numbered steps.

example_contrast.low_option: You should probably see a doctor if it doesn't get better soon.
example_contrast.high_option: 1. Monitor symptoms for 48 hours. 2. Contact a healthcare provider if symptoms persist.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the presence of clear formatting or structure, from 0 (free-flowing) to 5 (highly structured).

dimensions.name: Risk Orientation

low_pole.label: Risk-averse
low_pole.description: Emphasizes caution, safety, and minimizing harm.
low_pole.typical_person: A conservative clinician or public health official

high_pole.label: Risk-acceptant
high_pole.description: Acknowledges or even encourages calculated risk-taking in treatment or behavior.

example_contrast.low_option: Avoid all over-the-counter medications until you consult a doctor.
example_contrast.high_option: Some over-the-counter pain relievers may be safe to use in the short term.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emphasis on caution versus risk-taking, from 0 (very risk-averse) to 5 (very risk-acceptant).

dimensions.name: Temporal Orientation

low_pole.label: Present-focused
low_pole.description: Advice is centered on immediate actions or current symptoms.

high_pole.label: Future-oriented
high_pole.description: Advice emphasizes long-term planning, prevention, or future outcomes.
high_pole.typical_person: A public health or wellness advisor

example_contrast.low_option: Take this medication now to relieve your symptoms.
example_contrast.high_option: Adopting a healthy lifestyle now can reduce your risk of chronic disease in the future.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the focus on immediate actions versus long-term planning, from 0 (present-focused) to 5 (future-oriented).

dimensions.name: Tone Engagement

low_pole.label: Emotionally neutral
low_pole.description: Advice is delivered in a detached, clinical, or impersonal tone.

high_pole.label: Emotionally engaged
high_pole.description: Advice is delivered with empathy, warmth, or emotional support.
high_pole.typical_person: A patient-centered or community health worker

example_contrast.low_option: The symptoms are consistent with a viral infection.
example_contrast.high_option: I understand this is concerning, but it's likely a mild infection that will resolve on its own.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emotional tone of the advice, from 0 (neutral) to 5 (highly engaged).

dimensions.name: Audience Focus

low_pole.label: Institutional
low_pole.description: Advice is directed at healthcare systems, professionals, or organizations.
low_pole.typical_person: A policy advisor or hospital administrator

high_pole.label: Individual
high_pole.description: Advice is directed at patients, individuals, or families.
high_pole.typical_person: A primary care provider or patient educator

example_contrast.low_option: Health systems should invest in telemedicine infrastructure.
example_contrast.high_option: You can use telemedicine to consult with a doctor from home.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on whether the advice is directed at individuals or institutions, from 0 (institutional) to 5 (individual).

dimensions.name: Ethical Orientation

low_pole.label: Utilitarian
low_pole.description: Advice emphasizes efficiency, cost, or broader societal benefit.
low_pole.typical_person: A public health or policy advisor

high_pole.label: Patient-centered
high_pole.description: Advice emphasizes individual autonomy, values, and well-being.
high_pole.typical_person: A patient advocate or holistic care provider

example_contrast.low_option: Cost-effective treatments should be prioritized in public health programs.
example_contrast.high_option: Your preferences and comfort are important in deciding the best treatment for you.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emphasis on societal benefit versus individual well-being, from 0 (utilitarian) to 5 (patient-centered).

dimensions.name: Innovation Emphasis

low_pole.label: Traditional
low_pole.description: Advice relies on established practices, conventional wisdom, or standard care.

high_pole.label: Innovative
high_pole.description: Advice highlights new technologies, experimental approaches, or future trends.
high_pole.typical_person: A researcher or early adopter in healthcare

example_contrast.low_option: This is a standard treatment for the condition.
example_contrast.high_option: Emerging therapies using AI and genomics may offer new treatment options.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emphasis on traditional versus innovative approaches, from 0 (traditional) to 5 (innovative).

dimensions.name: Diversity Consideration

low_pole.label: Generalized
low_pole.description: Advice assumes a one-size-fits-all approach with little attention to diversity.

high_pole.label: Diverse
high_pole.description: Advice acknowledges and addresses differences in gender, culture, or identity.
high_pole.typical_person: A culturally competent or gender-sensitive provider

example_contrast.low_option: Everyone should follow the same guidelines.
example_contrast.high_option: Treatment may vary based on gender, age, and cultural background.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the inclusion of diversity considerations, from 0 (generalized) to 5 (highly diverse).

dimensions.name: Language Accessibility

low_pole.label: Technical
low_pole.description: Advice uses medical jargon, complex terms, or assumes clinical knowledge.

high_pole.label: Layperson-friendly
high_pole.description: Advice is simplified, avoids jargon, and is accessible to non-experts.
high_pole.typical_person: A patient educator or health communicator

example_contrast.low_option: The patient exhibits tachycardia and hypotension.
example_contrast.high_option: The patient has a fast heart rate and low blood pressure.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the use of technical versus accessible language, from 0 (technical) to 5 (layperson-friendly).

dimensions.name: Advisory Approach

low_pole.label: Supportive
low_pole.description: Advice is framed as encouragement, reassurance, or empowerment.
low_pole.typical_person: A patient advocate or wellness coach

high_pole.label: Directive
high_pole.description: Advice is framed as instructions, mandates, or clear expectations.

example_contrast.low_option: You can try this approach if it feels right for you.
example_contrast.high_option: You must follow this protocol to ensure safety.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the supportive versus directive tone, from 0 (supportive) to 5 (directive).

dimensions.name: Advisory Scope

low_pole.label: Narrow
low_pole.description: Advice is limited to a single condition, symptom, or treatment.

high_pole.label: Broad
high_pole.description: Advice addresses multiple conditions, systems, or broader health issues.
high_pole.typical_person: A public health or systems-level advisor

example_contrast.low_option: This medication is effective for treating high blood pressure.
example_contrast.high_option: Managing chronic conditions requires attention to diet, exercise, and mental health.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the breadth of the advice, from 0 (narrow) to 5 (broad).

dimensions.name: Advisory Authority

low_pole.label: Anecdotal
low_pole.description: Advice is based on personal experience, informal knowledge, or quick fixes.

high_pole.label: Evidence-based
high_pole.description: Advice is grounded in clinical research, guidelines, or expert consensus.

example_contrast.low_option: I took this and it worked for me.
example_contrast.high_option: This treatment is supported by clinical trials and is recommended by the CDC.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the basis of the advice, from 0 (anecdotal) to 5 (evidence-based).

dimensions.name: Advisory Tone

low_pole.label: Dismissive
low_pole.description: Advice is delivered with little emotional engagement or urgency.

high_pole.label: Engaged
high_pole.description: Advice is delivered with attention, concern, or active listening.

example_contrast.low_option: It's not a big deal. Just wait and see.
example_contrast.high_option: I understand this is worrying. Let's work together to find the best solution.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the level of engagement in the tone, from 0 (dismissive) to 5 (engaged).

dimensions.name: Advisory Complexity

low_pole.label: Simplified
low_pole.description: Advice is straightforward, easy to follow, and avoids complexity.

high_pole.label: Complex
high_pole.description: Advice includes multiple steps, conditions, or nuanced considerations.

example_contrast.low_option: Take this pill once a day.
example_contrast.high_option: Take this pill once daily with food, unless contraindicated by other medications.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the complexity of the advice, from 0 (simplified) to 5 (complex).

dimensions.name: Advisory Duration

low_pole.label: Short-term
low_pole.description: Advice is intended for immediate or temporary use.
low_pole.typical_person: A triage nurse or urgent care provider

high_pole.label: Long-term
high_pole.description: Advice is intended for ongoing or lifelong management.
high_pole.typical_person: A chronic care or wellness provider

example_contrast.low_option: Rest for a few days and you should feel better.
example_contrast.high_option: This condition requires ongoing monitoring and lifestyle adjustments.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the intended duration of the advice, from 0 (short-term) to 5 (long-term).

dimensions.name: Advisory Flexibility

low_pole.label: Rigid
low_pole.description: Advice is prescriptive, with little room for adaptation or choice.

high_pole.label: Flexible
high_pole.description: Advice allows for personalization, choice, or adaptation.

example_contrast.low_option: You must follow this exact regimen.
example_contrast.high_option: You can adjust the regimen based on your lifestyle and preferences.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the flexibility of the advice, from 0 (rigid) to 5 (flexible).

dimensions.name: Advisory Source

low_pole.label: Individual
low_pole.description: Advice is attributed to a single person or provider.
low_pole.typical_person: A private practitioner or individual clinician

high_pole.label: Institutional
high_pole.description: Advice is attributed to an organization, system, or guideline body.
high_pole.typical person: A public health or hospital communicator

example_contrast.low_option: I recommend this treatment based on my experience.
example_contrast.high_option: This treatment is recommended by the American Heart Association.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the source of the advice, from 0 (individual) to 5 (institutional).

dimensions.name: Advisory Ethical Transparency

low_pole.label: Implicit
low_pole.description: Ethical considerations are not explicitly addressed or acknowledged.
low_pole.typical person: A provider focused on clinical outcomes

high_pole.label: Explicit
high_pole.description: Ethical considerations are clearly addressed, including trade-offs or conflicts.
high_pole.typical person: An ethics consultant or patient advocate

example_contrast.low_option: This is the best treatment available.
example_contrast.high_option: This treatment is effective but may involve a conflict of interest with the manufacturer.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the explicitness of ethical considerations, from 0 (implicit) to 5 (explicit).

dimensions.name: Advisory Optimism

low_pole.label: Cautious
low_pole.description: Advice is delivered with a realistic or conservative outlook.
low_pole.typical person: A risk-averse provider or public health official

high_pole.label: Optimistic
high_pole.description: Advice is delivered with a positive, aspirational, or hopeful outlook.

example_contrast.low_option: There is a chance this may not work.
example_contrast.high_option: This is a promising approach with great potential for success.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the tone of optimism or caution, from 0 (cautious) to 5 (optimistic).

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Both dimensions relate to the clarity and detail of advice, but they differ in focus: Advice Specificity focuses on tailoring to conditions, while Advisory Complexity focuses on the number of steps or conditions included.
redundancy_check.resolution: They are kept as separate dimensions because they measure different aspects of advice detail.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Both dimensions relate to the emotional tone of the advice, but they differ in focus: Tone Engagement measures warmth and empathy, while Advisory Tone measures dismissiveness or engagement.
redundancy_check.resolution: They are kept as separate dimensions because they capture different emotional aspects of the advice.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Both dimensions relate to the approach of the advice, but they differ in focus: Ethical Orientation focuses on societal vs. individual values, while Advisory Approach focuses on supportive vs. directive tone.
redundancy_check.resolution: They are kept as separate dimensions because they capture different aspects of the advisory style.
